title: The Cloud Connector (ZTW) API from a client's side: hosts, sign-in, limits, coverage and wire notes

prose.text: Endpoint lists, HTTP methods, request and response fields, Go and Python SDK functions and ZTC Terraform resources are generated from the captured contract, the SDKs and the provider: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface ztw` and read `vendor/zscaler-api-specs/automate-zscaler/openapi/zcloudconnector.openapi.json`. This subject family holds only the behavior around them and the places where those sources disagree.

prose.label: Calling the API.
prose.text: Hosts and signing in, on the OneAPI gateway or the legacy connector host, are in [[cloud-connector.api.authentication]]. Limits and how the clients back off and retry are in [[cloud-connector.api.rate-limits]]. The base path, the contract's default responses, paging and decoding are in [[cloud-connector.api.conventions]]. Which client covers what is in [[cloud-connector.api.client-coverage]].

prose.label: Wire notes by area.
prose.text: Activation: [[cloud-connector.api.activation-wire]]. Cloud Connector groups and upgrades: [[cloud-connector.api.ec-groups-wire]]. Provisioning URLs: [[cloud-connector.api.provisioning-wire]]. Partner integrations (cloud accounts): [[cloud-connector.api.partner-integrations-wire]]. Forwarding and DNS rules: [[cloud-connector.api.rules-wire]]. Forwarding and DNS gateways: [[cloud-connector.api.gateways-wire]]. Locations: [[cloud-connector.api.locations-wire]].

prose.label: Clients.
prose.text: Go SDK service defects are in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.service-defects]] and its coverage in [[cloud-connector.sdk-go.coverage]]; the Python SDK's coverage and client settings are in [[cloud-connector.sdk-python.coverage]] and [[cloud-connector.sdk-python.client-configuration]]. The ZTC provider's configuration and field handling are in [[cloud-connector.terraform.provider-config]] and [[cloud-connector.terraform.provider-behavior]], with rule order, delete handling and predefined-rule protection in [[cloud-connector.terraform.rule-order]], [[cloud-connector.terraform.delete-detach]] and [[cloud-connector.terraform.rule-protection]]. Behavior shared by all Go products is in [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling]], [[shared.sdk-go.retries]], [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination]] and [[shared.sdk-go.zero-value-writes]].
